description: North Sea Oil Offshore Maps and GIS - Netherland sector is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "Mineral Resources/Oil and Gas", published or maintained by the publisher of nlog.nl. Same as above but for Netherland-controlled area of the North Sea. Coverage: worldwide or as described in the list entry. The list files it under "Mineral Resources/Oil and Gas". The entry links to nlog.nl. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
